test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Town B is to the north of Town A. Town C is to the east of Town B. Town D is to the north of Town C. Town E is to the west of Town D. What is the position of Town E with respect to Town A? (All positions are arranged in GRID pattern)
solution:
Given: 

Town B is to the north of Town A.

Town C is to the east of Town B.

Town D is to the north of Town C.

Town E is to the west of Town D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76af338df3f549268a78e88ac89ede34b20221822a2422d404cab7086f87afb3.png] 

So, Town E is in 'North' direction of Town A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
